lean.source:
/-- **Fisher's fundamental theorem of natural selection** (haploid locus, partial change).
The change in mean fitness over one generation of selection, with fitnesses held fixed, equals
the variance in fitness divided by the mean fitness. -/
theorem fisher_fundamental_theorem {p w : ι → ℝ} (hp : IsFreq p)
    (hmean : 0 < meanFitness p w) :
    meanFitness (select p w) w - meanFitness p w = variance p w / meanFitness p w := by
  have hne := hmean.ne'
  rw [variance_eq hp]
  have h : meanFitness (select p w) w = (∑ i, p i * w i ^ 2) / meanFitness p w := by
    show ∑ i, (p i * w i / meanFitness p w) * w i = _
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
  rw [h]
  field_simp

named_hypotheses.name: Delphi.IsFreq
named_hypotheses.source:
/-- A frequency vector: nonnegative and summing to one. -/
structure IsFreq (p : ι → ℝ) : Prop where
  nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i
  sum_one : ∑ i, p i = 1

constraint_details.canEliminate: a candidate that commits to all three quantities as exact values violating the identity
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C4, Fisher.** A candidate that commits to a change in mean fitness `Δ`, a mean fitness `m > 0` and a
variance in fitness `V` under one round of selection with fixed fitnesses, with `Δ · m ≠ V`, is ruled out. -/
theorem fisher_rules_out {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p w : ι → ℝ} (hp : IsFreq p)
    (hmean : 0 < meanFitness p w) {Δ V m : ℝ}
    (hΔ : meanFitness (select p w) w - meanFitness p w = Δ) (hV : variance p w = V)
    (hm : meanFitness p w = m) (h : Δ * m ≠ V) : False := by
  have := fisher_fundamental_theorem' hp hmean
  rw [hΔ, hV, hm] at this
  exact h this

constraint_details.canEliminate: a candidate that says mean fitness falls under constant selection at one locus without mutation, drift, frequency dependence or environmental change
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C4b, Fisher's sign.** A candidate that says mean fitness falls under one round of selection with
fixed fitnesses is ruled out. -/
theorem fisher_decline_rules_out {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p w : ι → ℝ} (hp : IsFreq p)
    (hmean : 0 < meanFitness p w) {b : ℝ}
    (hΔ : meanFitness (select p w) w - meanFitness p w ≤ b) (h : b < 0) : False := by
  have := mean_fitness_nondecreasing hp hmean
  linarith

constraint_details.canEliminate: a candidate that says selection changes mean fitness while committing to zero variance in fitness
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C4c, Fisher with zero variance.** If the variance in fitness is `0`, mean fitness does not change at
all: a candidate that commits to zero variance and a nonzero change is ruled out. -/
theorem fisher_zero_variance_rules_out {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p w : ι → ℝ} (hp : IsFreq p)
    (hmean : 0 < meanFitness p w) (hV : variance p w = 0) {Δ : ℝ}
    (hΔ : meanFitness (select p w) w - meanFitness p w = Δ) (h : Δ ≠ 0) : False := by
  have := fisher_fundamental_theorem hp hmean
  rw [hΔ, hV, zero_div] at this
  exact h this
